lines.text: Settled in his palace, David tells Nathan he lives in a cedar house while the ark stays in a tent.
God says He has moved about with a tent since Egypt and took David from the pasture to rule Israel.
God promises David's descendant will build a house for His Name and keep His devotion, unlike Eli.
David sits before the LORD and asks who he is to be brought this far, saying God knows His servant.
David says God drove out nations and their gods and asks that He be called God over Judah.
